deliverables.description: A revised engineering document incorporating verified updates from engineering change notices and current design specifications, with tracked or summarized revisions for internal record-keeping.

information_nodes.description: The current draft or previously released engineering document that requires review and maintenance.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Engineering documents routinely combine textual specifications with schematic diagrams; both may need to be read and updated.

information_nodes.description: Engineering change notices or revision requests describing modifications to be applied to the document.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Change notices are typically textual records that may include tabular lists of affected parameters or part numbers.

information_nodes.description: Current design specifications or technical data that define the correct parameters, tolerances, or configurations the document must reflect.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Design specifications are commonly maintained as structured text with tabular parameter data.

information_nodes.description: Discrepancies between the existing engineering document and the current design specifications or engineering change notices.
Specific textual and diagrammatic revisions needed to bring the engineering document into alignment with current specifications and change notices.
Judgment that all necessary revisions have been identified and that the updated document is complete, internally consistent, and suitable for internal release.

modality_hypotheses.information_needed: Schematic diagrams or engineering drawings embedded in the document that must be visually interpreted to verify that depicted components, connections, and configurations match current specifications.
modality_hypotheses.modality_rationale: Automotive engineering documents frequently include diagrams whose correctness cannot be assessed through text alone; the spatial relationships and component representations must be visually inspected.

work_objective: Review and update an existing automotive engineering document so that it accurately reflects current design specifications and engineering change decisions, producing a maintained revision suitable for internal use.

deliverables.description: A structured list of the guidance documents, international standards, and consensus standards identified as relevant, with each source named, its issuing body noted, and its applicability to the situation stated.
deliverables.type: Curated standards and guidance reference list

information_nodes.description: The regulatory context defining the subject area, product or activity in scope, and any applicable jurisdictions or markets.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Scope and context are conveyed as written narrative in the request.

information_nodes.description: Internal or workspace source materials describing the organization's product, process, or activity that the standards must apply to.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Technical descriptions and specification tables typically document the product or activity.

information_nodes.description: Reference sources listing guidance documents, international standards, and consensus standards, including titles, issuing bodies, and scope statements.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Standards catalogs and registers present titles and scope information as text and tabular metadata.

information_nodes.description: The technical subject matter and criteria of the organization's product or activity that determine which categories of standards apply.
The jurisdictions and regulatory domains that govern the activity and therefore constrain which standards are relevant.
A mapping of candidate standards and guidance documents to the derived subject matter and jurisdictional criteria, showing where each candidate matches or fails to match.
Determination of which candidate standards and guidance documents are relevant and applicable to the regulatory situation, with justification for inclusions and exclusions.
For each selected source, the specific applicability rationale linking the standard's scope to the organization's activity and governing requirements.

work_objective: Identify the guidance documents, international standards, and consensus standards relevant to a given regulatory situation, and produce a curated reference list documenting each identified source and its relevance.
